t: You're in St John's Park, a housing estate near Clapham Junction. It was commissioned by Alfred Heaver, who lived from 1841 to 1901. Heaver started out as a carpenter, became a builder and property developer, and was responsible for housing estates amounting to thousands of homes in south London. The best known of these is the Heaver Estate in Balham. In 1901 he was murdered by a relative who nursed a grudge against him. So the streets around you are part of a much larger body of homes he built.
